title: Parse RGB
prompt: Implement `int parse_rgb(const char* text, int* r, int* g, int* b)` parsing decimal colors like `"12, 200, 3"` (comma-separated, optional spaces). Return 1 only when all three parsed, else 0.

tests.name: valid rgb
tests.hint: sscanf(text, "%d , %d , %d", r, g, b) — spaces in the format match any whitespace.
